mintCLAndStake((address,address,address,.details: Mint a concentrated-liquidity position, optionally enter farming via GaugeCL,      and then transfer the NFT to the user. Flow: - User approves this router for token0 and token1. - Router pulls `amount0Desired`/`amount1Desired` from user and transfers to RouterHelper. - RouterHelper handles minting, optionally staking in gauge (if exists), refunding dust, and transferring NFT to user. Note: Any unused token0/token1 remaining after mint are refunded to the user by RouterHelper. If user sent native ETH, it will be wrapped into WETH and used for the mint.
